PRICING                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
Pricing shall be inclusive of all labor, equipment, supplies, overhead, profit, material, and any other incidental costs required to perform and complete all work as specified in the Contract Documents. All Unit Prices will be bid at the nearest whole penny.  The Excel document may contain formulas for convenience, however it is the Contractor’s/Vendor's responsibility to verify all pricing and calculations are CORRECT. Lee County is not responsible for errors in formulas or calculations contained within Excel document(s).  

The County will only accept bids submitted on bid forms provided by the County. Bids submitted on other forms, other than those provided by the County, shall be deemed non-responsive and ineligible for award.

Contractor(s) are not required to bid all line items; however, Contractor(s) are asked to bid all lines applicable to their company for services they can provide under this contract. Where the Contractor cannot provide for a commodity or service, it is requested the Contractor indicate No Bid on the line item tab.

Contractor(s) who “no bid” an item cannot provide that item anytime throughout the term of this agreement including all renewals.
